notes: Version B (4x/8x cluster highlighted) of Figure 1, overwritten to add a 3rd panel. Figure 1. Histograms of the per-site ratio of ERA5-derived mean annual precipitation (MAP) to three independent references, 781 current-network sites. Panel 1 (ERA5/BIO12): n=780; excludes 1 site with era5_map_mm == 0 (CA-TP2). Panel 2 (ERA5/BADM): n=631; excludes 150 sites (144 no BADM value, 5 BADM MAP == 0, 1 era5_map_mm == 0). Panel 3 (ERA5/tower-measured, NEW): n=469; excludes 312 sites (312 with no calendar year where all 12 months have P_F_QC >= 0.9, 1 era5_map_mm == 0; measured_map_mm was never exactly 0 in this network). X-axis is log10(ratio); bin width 0.1 log10 units (~26% per bin); range not clipped, extends to the full observed range in each panel. Dashed reference lines at ratio = 1x, 4x, 8x. Version B: the 123 sites in the 4x/8x cluster are shown in a second colour; see legend for the membership rule.
